Holly is an MLS area name in Ladner. Holly Park is at 4681 62 Street and Holly Elementary is at 4625 62 Street.
Is there an official Holly boundary?
Holly is an MLS® sub-area name used by the real estate board rather than an official municipal boundary, so ask me to verify any specific address.
Holly Park at 4681 62 Street, with a walking circuit, Kensington Park at 6467 Holly Park Drive with pickleball and tennis, Bell Park at 5900 49A Avenue and Association Park at 4695 60B Street.
Holly Elementary is at 4625 62 Street. Check the Delta School District school locator for your address.
Is Holly in a flood zone?
Holly is on the same low land as the rest of Ladner. Delta has over 63 km of dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection and expects upgrades because of sea level rise. Ask about the exact lot.
